question: Which of the following states is associated with Bonalu festival?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Telangana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bonalu** is a Hindu festival celebrated in the state of **Telangana**, India.
 
• This festival is dedicated to the goddess Mahakali and is **celebrated to ward off evil and bring about prosperity**.
 
• Bonalu is marked by the **offering of meals to the goddess**, which are carried in pots by women.
 
• The festival usually takes place during the month of **Ashada Masam**, which falls in** July and August**.
 
• It is considered one of the major cultural festivals in Telangana, with grand celebrations especially in the city of Hyderabad and Secunderabad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The festival involves a procession where the goddess is taken around the streets, accompanied by traditional music and dance.
 
• In addition to religious rituals, Bonalu also features cultural events, fairs, and other forms of entertainment.
 
• Bonalu has been declared as a state festival by the government of Telangana.
 
• The word "**Bonam**" is a contraction of the word "**Bhojanam**," which means a **meal or a feast in Telugu**, symbolizing the food offering to the goddess.
